skills.name: Writing about violence and criminality in school

note.text:
An expository (or argumentative) essay on a problem: introduction (the problem and why it matters); causes; consequences; solutions; conclusion with your opinion.
Use complex sentences (because, although, if), linking words (firstly, moreover, however, therefore) and formal language.

worked_example.problem: Plan an essay on violence and criminality in school.
steps: Introduction: violence, drugs and bullying in some schools.
Causes: drugs, bad company, lack of supervision, films.
Consequences: injuries, fear, poor results, expulsions.
Solutions: clubs, counsellors, reporting, school rules, parents' involvement.

cards.idea: Plan: problem, causes, consequences, solutions, conclusion.

example: Because some pupils take drugs, they become aggressive.

cards.idea: End with your opinion and a call to act.

questions.prompt: Put the sentences of the essay in order.

items.text: Violence and drugs are a growing problem in some schools.
Firstly, some pupils take drugs because they want to look strong.
As a result, they become aggressive and bully others.
However, clubs and counsellors can help.
Therefore, everyone must report violence at once.

paper_task.prompt: Write an essay of about 180 words in your exercise book: “Violence and criminality in our schools: causes, consequences and solutions”.
model:
Violence and criminality are a growing problem in some of our schools. Fights, bullying, theft and drug abuse make many pupils afraid.

There are several causes. Firstly, some pupils take drugs because they think drugs make them strong. Secondly, bad company and violent films teach them that force is normal. Moreover, large classes make it hard for teachers to watch every pupil.

The consequences are serious. Victims are injured or frightened, and some stop coming to school. The culprits are suspended or expelled, and their results fall.

However, there are solutions. Schools should have counsellors and anti-drug clubs, and the rules must be applied fairly. Parents should know their children's friends. Above all, pupils must report every case of violence.

Therefore, if everyone acts, our schools can again be places of peace and learning.
checklist: I gave causes, consequences and solutions in separate paragraphs.
I used complex sentences (because, although, if).
